non_blocking: G1 CKA-08 input: ServiceContract.php:113-183 (windowsDataDriveRoot, ntfsFileSystemTypes, linuxDataDirCandidates, homeDataDirFallback) have no caller yet, and PathMapper.php:44-57 still holds the same values as constants, so there are two sources until CKA-08 lands. CKA-08 must consume these readers and delete the PathMapper constants. PathMapper.php:53 LEGACY_WINDOWS_PROGRAMING_USERS_DIR is a const expression on WINDOWS_DATA_DRIVE_ROOT, so it becomes a method; the internal uses are at :61, :67-68, :114-122, :281-298, :325, :422-501, :585, :701, :882-883 and :1638, and nothing outside PathMapper uses these constants. There is no recursion risk: ServiceContract::document() resolves the repo root through PathMapper::getCoreNodeDir() (:1577, __FILE__-based), not through the data dir. If CKA-08 is dropped, delete the four readers.

ServiceContract.php:185-193 dataSync() has no caller. Its docblock says 'DataSyncProtocol is its typed reader', but DataSyncProtocol.php:28-75 reads through positiveInt/stringList and never calls it. G1 contract-readers should either replace it with a generic ServiceContract::section(string $path) (ContractDocument::section), which the raw document()[...] readers adopt, or delete it. Those readers are ClientKeyAuthService.php:254 and DingDuoDuoV1SuperCodeService.php:124 (pycore-laravel) and CodeMartV1AdminPassword.php:30 (codemart-laravel, through codemart-lead).

ContractDocument.php:8-11 says 'A missing or mistyped key throws', but the public value() at :14-26 returns null. value() has no outside caller, so make it private, or reword the docblock. When G1 extends QueueCenterContract (contract-readers), use ContractDocument for the new typed reads instead of more '?? default' reads, so the class stops having a single consumer.
